atlas_fit.current_problem: Atlas needs reproducible on-device model packaging and device-compatibility evidence for Apple endpoints.
atlas_fit.future_risk: Converted model catalogs can mix repository, converter, model, and dataset licenses and may overstate device compatibility.

claims.claim: The repository documents Core AI model conversions, reproducible recipes, model cards, and device-verification claims for Apple platforms.
The repository-level BSD license applies uniformly to every converted model and its upstream weights.

excluded_classes: raw financial, legal, tax, insurance, mortgage, estate, brokerage, or account evidence

unresolved: Runtime behavior, security effectiveness, performance, and compatibility were not independently executed or benchmarked in this Mission.
